description: Check that every grant is alive, per product and per account. Under `gmail`, per grant: the mailbox each credential resolves to, the scope Google actually GRANTED (not the one credentials.json declares), whether it can write, and the OAuth client the live token belongs to; an account may hold its own gmail.modify grant and a gmail.readonly one, and `activeGrant` is the one the tools use. Under `calendar`: that the grant refreshes, which account it resolves to (the consent screen offers every account signed in), and whether it carries the scopes the tools need. Under `drive`: which account the grant acts as and the storage used. Under `editors` (Docs, Sheets, Slides), per account: the address, the granted scopes, and whether each of the three APIs is enabled in the grant's Cloud project. Under `tasks`, `contacts` and `meet`, per account with a grant: the address, the granted scopes, and whether the API answers (`disabled` when its Cloud project has not enabled it); contacts also says which sources it reads. Under `config`: where the state directory, the OAuth client, the mailboxes and each account's address come from (a variable, or what setup or a consent saved; a variable that is set wins). Checks EVERY account by default. Run this before concluding the server is broken, and before retrying a write that refused.

account.description: Which account: a label from list_accounts, or "*" for every account (the default).
